summary: A four-voice wavetable FM synthesizer firmware: each voice has two oscillators made of three morphing wavetable operators, with a drum lane, sequencer and looper alongside. The same engine runs in a browser editor and a CLAP plugin.
features: Two 3-operator wavetable oscillators per voice; FM, ring or mix
Two-part sounds (DUAL, SPLIT, LAYER); 96 factory tones, 24 attack transients
Self-oscillating or comb filter, two LFOs, looping envelopes, mod matrix
303-style sequencer: 4 patterns up to 64 steps, chords, step locks
Kick, snare, hat and clap lane; note looper up to 8 bars
USB audio, MIDI and clock; TRS MIDI in; 4 voices, 8 patch slots

headings: tests on the computer, no fm-1 needed
